claims: Tulsa defeated New Mexico 74-69 in the 2026 NIT Semifinals
The game was at Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, IN
David Green led Tulsa with 13 points
Jake Hall scored 18 points for the Lobos
Tulsa advanced to the NIT championship game
Tulsa Golden Hurricane 74, New Mexico Lobos 69
David Green scored 13 pts for Tulsa
Ade Popoola scored 12 pts for Tulsa
Miles Barnstable scored 11 pts for Tulsa
Jake Hall scored 18 pts for New Mexico
JT Rock scored 16 pts for New Mexico
